title: feat(app-shell): one top bar above the record header on every face, the enlarged related list draws a toolbar, and Activity counts on a deep link
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgVP3twvBvDTwoLPU6J _Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuP5SeDdTXdueuof1bJtgkLy)_ Fixes #27524 Clause-②: yes (widening: `@object-ui/components` gains `RecordTopBar`, `RecordTopBarButton`, `useRecordStepKeys` and the types `RecordTopBarProps` / `RecordTopBarStepper`; `NavigationOverlay` gains an optional `toggles` prop and its `stepper` an optional `position` and `scope`; `@object-ui/i18n` gains eight `detail.*` keys in all ten locales; no entry export retires and no accept set moves. The claim's provisional `no` is corrected here, measured on the diff.) Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么**：记录在每一种呈现方式里（整页、分屏面板、覆盖抽屉、最大化、手机）都在记录头上方画一条 40 px 顶栏。左边是面包屑「对象 › 记录名」（点对象回列表；面板下一层仍是「← 路径」）；右边按固定顺序只画适用的控件：计数「3 / 21」和 ↓ ↑、⊟、⤢ / ⤡、✕。原来记录头上方的面包屑行（‹ 来源、收为抽屉）删掉，⊟ 从记录头操作行移进顶栏。另带两项（③ 预览闸门裁定）：放大的相关列表画看板工具栏（筛选、全部 / 我的 / 逾期、新建、导出）而不是卡片头尾；深链到别的标签时「动态」标签也显示条数。 - **为什么改**：#27524 Target 7 和 Target 4 的 ⊟ 部分（画布 60 定稿），四个串行 PR 的最后一个，带 `Fixes #27524`。 - **风险与回滚**：只动 ui 包（components、app-shell、plugin-detail、十个语言包），不碰 spec、不碰服务端。没有退役任何入口导出（`PanelToggles`、`PageHeaderTrailingContext` 都保留，宿主自己的普通覆盖层仍把 ⊟ 放在记录头末尾），所以是 widening。整页上的计数和 ↓ ↑ 只在从列表打开时出现（行的 ↗，或行本身就开整页的列表，比如 HotCRM 线索），用 `replace` 换页，不增历史；⤡ 只给 ↗ 打开的整页。回滚即 revert 本 PR。 - **先看**：`ui/packages/components/src/custom/record-top-bar.tsx`（顶栏和 j / k 归属）；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` 的 `pageLeading` / `pageBar`；`recordDrawerStack.tsx` 的 `useRecordPageReturn` 和 `RecordPaneBarToggles`；`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx` 的 `enlargedFace`。 - **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/__tests__/record-top-bar-27524.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.topBar-27524.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.tabRow-27524.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524.test.tsx`，预期 5 个文件 34 个测试全绿。 - **需要你做的**：无，席位做预览闸门（HotCRM 截图对照 v4 画板）后落地。 ## What changes Record page v4, Target 7 and the ⊟ half of Target 4, plus the two ride-alongs ruled at ③'s preview gate. PR ④ of the four serial PRs for #27524, cut from `main` after ③ (#28394, `bf74607954`). ### The top bar (Target 7) `RecordTopBar` (`@object-ui/components`, new `custom/record-top-bar.tsx`) is one 40 px row above the record header. The page, the split pane, the overlay drawer, the maximized pane and a phone all draw this one component. - **Left: the breadcrumb.** - At the pane's root it reads 「对象 › 记录名」 (for example 「线索 › Mira Costa」). The object name closes the pane, which returns to the list. - One level down in the pane, the bar keeps 「← 路径」 as #26679 drew it. - On the page, the object goes to the list the page was opened from (the `?from=` origin, without the record the list had open) or else to the object's list. - A page opened under a `?from=` trail draws ← and the path, and each ancestor links to its own page. - The record's name in the pane bar comes from the record itself, through `RecordPaneBarContext.reportTitle`. - **Right, in a fixed order.** First the counter 「n / N」 and ↓ ↑, then a hairline, then ⊟, then ⤢ / ⤡, then ✕. Each one is drawn only where it applies: - **The pane.** The counter and ↓ ↑ show whenever the list reported its rows (#26679's sibling set). The tooltip names the list: 「全部线索 中第 3 条，共 21 条」. ✕ closes the whole path. - **The page.** The counter and ↓ ↑ show only for a page a list opened. That is the row's ↗, or a row click or record link on a list whose rows open as pages, as HotCRM's lead list does. Every navigation the list makes to a record's page (`handleNavOverlayNavigate`) now hands the shown rows in the page's `from` state when the record is one of them, and the ↗ also hands them in its way back to the pane. ↓ ↑ and `j` / `k` replace the page with the sibling's page, keep the list's state, and drop `?related=`. On the page the arrow keys still scroll. - **⤡ 「收为抽屉」** shows only for a page the row's ↗ opened. It returns to the list with the record you stepped to open in the pane. A list whose rows open as pages opens no pane, so there is nothing to collapse to. - **A page opened directly** shows only ⊟. It has no counter, no ⤡ and no ✕. - **The step keys** belong to the latest host. While a pane is open over a page, the pane owns `j` / `k` until it closes (`useRecordStepKeys` keeps an owner stack). - **What goes.** The crumb row above the record header goes: the 「‹ origin」 and 「收为抽屉」 row, together with its small ‹ line. The header's action row keeps the business actions only. ### ⊟ in the top bar (Target 4) The right-column switch (「右栏」, ⌘⇧,) leaves the header's action row. - On the page it is drawn in the page's top bar. - In the pane, the record portals it into the pane's own bar (`RecordPaneBarToggles` into the bar's `data-record-pane-toggles` slot). - It is drawn only where the face's tier has a right column, the rule ② already applied to `PanelToggles`. - A host's plain overlay without the console's pane (`InterfaceListPage`, `ObjectDataPage`) has no bar slot. It keeps ⊟ at the end of the header's action row through `PageHeaderTrailingContext`, so that export stays. ### Ride-along (a): the enlarged related list draws the board toolbar When a related list is the active tab, `RecordPageColumns` provides `RelatedListEnlargedContext`. `RelatedList` then draws: - **A toolbar** (`role="toolbar"`) over the table, in place of the card header and the card foot. The toolbar holds: - the filter input; - the chips 全部 N / 我的 / 逾期; - the child object's toolbar actions; - 新建; - 导出. - **A status line** 「N 条 · 第 x / y 页」 between the toolbar and the table. - **The table at the face's full height.** Each chip is drawn only where the child object declares what it says: - **我的** where the object has an `owner_id` column. It filters with `{ owner_id: '{current_user_id}' }`. - **逾期** where a `date` / `datetime` field declares `dueLike: true` with no `settledWhen`. It filters with `{ field: { $lt: '{today}' } }`. A `settledWhen` is CEL that no query can ask, so such a field gets no chip. - **全部** alone is no choice, so then no chip group is drawn. A chip narrows the list's own read: it is merged beside the parent scope with `mergeFilterNodes`. **导出** downloads a CSV through `dataSource.exportDownload`. It sends the same parent, chip and list filter, the filter text as `search`, the shown columns and the order. ### Ride-along (b): 动态's count on a deep link `RecordTimelineCountProbe` (in `record-activity.tsx`) reads the feed the page already holds and reports its size to the tab row. The feed is the discussion context, the field-change context, and the node's types and `showCompleted`. The probe starts no read of its own. It is mounted only when the 动态 tab is not active and the stream is not drawn elsewhere: a deep link to another tab, or ⊟ off. Before ④, 动态 had no count there until the stream was drawn once (③'s noted gap). ### i18n Eight keys arrive in all ten packs, with each pack's plural forms: `detail.recordOfScope`, `detail.relatedFilter`, `detail.relatedChips`, `detail.relatedChipAll`, `detail.relatedChipMine`, `detail.relatedChipOverdue`, `detail.relatedExport` and `detail.relatedRows`. ### File surface beyond the claim - `app-shell`: - `ObjectView.tsx`, `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` and `objectViewRecordOverlay.tsx`: the view's label as the counter's scope, and the shown rows handed to every page the list opens. - `recordDrawerContext.ts`: the pane bar context. - `urlParams.ts`: one state-key constant. - `components`: `custom/record-top-bar.tsx` and its line in `custom/index.ts`, in place of `renderers/layout/containers.tsx`. The bar is a frame component, not a page-layout slot, so `containers.tsx` is untouched. `panel-toggles.tsx` is untouched too: ⊟ is still `PanelToggles`, drawn in a new place. - `plugin-detail`: `RelatedList.tsx`, `relatedListCompact.ts`, `renderers/record-activity.tsx` and `useDetailTranslation.ts`, for the two ride-alongs. #27545's split / overlay / maximize mechanics are not changed. `NavigationOverlay` only draws its existing ⤢ / ⤡ / ✕ into the shared bar. ## Tests New: - `components/src/__tests__/record-top-bar-27524.test.tsx` (6): - the right end's fixed order; - the counter's text and its tooltip naming the list; - only what is handed is drawn; - the pair without a counter; - the step-key owner stack: a page steps with `j` / `k` but not the arrows, a pane over it takes the keys until it closes, and a pane with no set holds them without stepping the page; - `NavigationOverlay` drawing the shared bar. - `app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.topBar-27524.test.tsx` (7), a real `RecordDetailView`: - a direct page: the crumb, only ⊟, no crumb row; - a page from ↗: the counter 「2 / 3」 with its scope, ↓ to the sibling by `replace`, `k` back, ArrowUp ignored, ⤡ back to `?recordId=` with the restore state; - a page a list opened as a page: 「1 / 3」 with its scope, no ⤡, `j` and ↑ step, and the next page keeps the same `from` state; - control: an origin without its rows draws no counter; - the object crumb back to the origin list; - a `?from=` trail with ← and the ancestors; - the pane: ⊟ portalled into the pane's bar, the record's title reported to the crumb, one bar only, the scope tooltip. - `app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524.test.tsx` (3), the list's navigation hook: - a row that opens as a page hands the origin, the view's name and the shown rows; - control: a record the list does not show gets the origin alone; - the row's ↗ hands the rows both in the way back to the pane and in the origin. - `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524.test.tsx` (5): - the toolbar with no card; - 我的 and 逾期 narrowing the read beside the parent; - a chip drawn only where the object declares it; - 导出 with the parent and the chip; - control: outside the active tab the card face stays. - `plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RecordPageColumns.tabRow-27524.test.tsx` (+3): - 动态's count on a deep link to another tab; - control: no count while the feed is loading or absent; - the count with ⊟ off. Pins updated to the new anatomy, not deleted: - `RecordDetailView.panelToggles-27052` (#27052): ⊟ in the top bar, nothing in the header's trailing slot, no crumb row, the bar before the header. - `recordDrawerStack-26679` and `recordDrawerStack.rootStepper-26679` (#26679): the root crumb 「对象 › 记录名」 and the counter. - `RelatedCardStack-27055` (#27055): the enlarged face's stub sees the enlarged context. - `RecordDetailView.pageHeaderTitleFls-10499`: the record's gated name now appears twice, in the H1 and in the top bar's crumb. The pin checks that the crumb names the same gated title and never the denied email, and that the body still shows the name once. - `residue-namespaces-3546`: RelatedList's `detail.add` sites number four with the toolbar's Add. - The #26678 pins (`RecordDetailView.recordPageTiers-26678`, `RelatedList.compactColumn-26678`) needed no change and ran green in the broad suite below. No test file is named for #27473. The plugin-detail package and the record-view tests, where its pins would sit, ran in full in that suite.
Eleven ablations (each through node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs, restore proven blob == HEAD) - The page's bar not drawn: `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524`, 4 failed. - The pane toggles not portalled: 1 failed. - The page stepper withheld: 1 failed. - The page's `from` rows not read (`readFromSiblings`): `RecordDetailView.topBar-27524`, 1 failed | 6 passed. - The list's navigation not handing its rows in `from`: `objectViewRecordNavigation.listRows-27524`, 2 failed | 1 passed. - The root crumb reverted to the bare path: 1 failed. - The step-key owner stack disabled (every host steps): `record-top-bar-27524`, 2 failed. - The count probe not mounted: `RecordPageColumns.tabRow-27524`, 2 failed. - The enlarged face off: `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524`, 4 failed | 1 passed. - The chip left out of the read: `RelatedList.enlargedToolbar-27524`, 2 failed | 3 passed. - The enlarged context not provided by `RecordPageColumns`: `RelatedCardStack-27055`, 1 failed | 12 passed.
## Acceptance notes **Screenshots on HotCRM** against the v4 boards at `a7825499aa`, zh-CN. They are committed on this branch in `b0a817c91d` and removed again in the next commit, so they never reach `main`. The folder's [README](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/b0a817c91dcac099c993f1a9246198079159f5a6/evidence/record-page-v4-top-bar/README.md) says how they were made, and [`facts.json`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/b0a817c91dcac099c993f1a9246198079159f5a6/evidence/record-page-v4-top-bar/facts.json) records each shot's top bar as read from the DOM. HotCRM runs on this branch's own server. The published 18.2.0 server has no `POST /data/:object/:id/page`, which the console's record page now reads, so it shows 「未找到记录」. Three of HotCRM's lead form views declare the form `type`s that spec 18.3.0 retired; in the rig's clone only, they were set to `simple`. | Shot | What the top bar shows | Board | |:--|:--|:--| | [`01-lead-1440-from-list.png`](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/b0a817c91dcac099c993f1a9246198079159f5a6/evidence/record-page-v4-top-bar/01-lead-1440-from-list.png?raw=true) | Lead at 1440, opened from the lead list. Every top bar measures 40 px. Not built here, reported: - **The counter's group scope.** Target 7 says the tooltip names the group when the list was grouped or is a kanban column. `ListView` reports its row sequence only for the paged, ungrouped grid (#26679, `rowSequenceShown`). On a grouped list or a kanban board the pane therefore has no sibling set and draws no counter at all; the HotCRM contact list, grouped by account, is one. Naming the group needs `ListView` (plugin-list, outside this claim) to report grouped and lane rows with their group. That is a follow-up. - **逾期 on HotCRM.** `crm_task.due_date` does not declare `dueLike`, so HotCRM's 任务 tab shows 全部 / 我的 only. The chip appears where an object declares the deadline. - **The object crumb.** It returns to the list without a pane, so the board's "the record you last saw stays selected" is not drawn: the list has no selection without a pane. ⤡ is the path that returns with the record open. - **导出.** It sends the filter text to the server as `search`, while the table's own text filter is a client-side contains sweep over the fetched page. The CSV can differ where the server's search matches other fields. - **The phone.** It draws the same bar. The board's phone header (‹ title ↑ ↓ ⋯) and bottom action bar are a separate face and are not in ④. - **The app header's crumb** is unchanged (#27950 holds the list title, per the release). ## Human Minimum Each item is one rule from [CONTRIBUTING.md › Human Minimum](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#human-minimum), which links the AGENTS.md text that states it. - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`packages/spec` is not touched.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; eslint on the changed files: 0 errors. - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (Not touched.) - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the project's Chinese summary). - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. ## Verification All local readings are at head `d94e010b0a`, which includes the merge of `origin/main` `5517005d3a`. Against that merge base the change is 37 paths, +2,125 / −303. The evidence folder is added and removed inside the range, so it is not among them.
Tests, type-check, lint - **Broad suite.** Under the verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3 packages/plugin-detail packages/components packages/i18n` plus the 619 other test files under `ui/` that name a module, test id or key this PR changes, derived by `git grep`. - The run was on `6c535caa83`: `Test Files 4 failed | 1529 passed | 2 skipped (1535)`, `Tests 10 failed | 17140 passed | 67 skipped (17217)`. - All ten reds came from this change, in four files: - `all-locales-key-parity` and `plural-categories-11432`: fr / es / pt lacked `detail.relatedRows_many`, and ar's `_one` / `_two` lacked `{{count}}`; - `residue-namespaces-3546`: RelatedList's `detail.add` count, now 4 with the toolbar's Add; - `RecordDetailView.pageHeaderTitleFls-10499`: the record's name now also appears in the top bar's crumb. The pin now checks that the crumb names the same gated title and never the denied email. - All four were fixed in `d94e010b0a`, and the four files rerun green: `Tests 107 passed (107)`. - **Type-check.** `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit` + `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) of `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` under the lock, and `@object-ui/i18n` at `d94e010b0a`: each exit 0. - **eslint** on the 36 added or modified `ts` / `tsx` files under `ui/` at `d94e010b0a`: 0 errors. The warnings left on added lines are `react-refresh/only-export-components` on the hook exports beside components, a pattern these files already follow. - **`pnpm --dir ui run check:i18n-drift`**: exit 0.
Derived gate families: 34 derived, 34 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives the same 34 commands at `857d25f771` and at `d94e010b0a`. Each was run at `d94e010b0a` with stdin from `/dev/null`, and its exit code was captured before any pipe.
